notes: Dimensions from Sony's 2010-01-14 CECH-2000B release (sonyinteractive.com; the old corporate/release/2010/100114a.html URL redirects there); the 2009-08-18 CECH-2000A release (sony.mediaroom.com) prints the same 290 x 65 x 290 mm and 3.2 kg but splits the line across table cells. Sony labels the third axis 'length' (width × height × length); it is recorded as depth, the front-to-back axis of a console standing on its feet. Excluding the maximum projecting part, so the source covers dimensions_mm.

ports = the release's Inputs/Outputs, Networking and AV output rows. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. Sony's input/output row does not list the AC inlet, so ports has no power_in item; that absence is Sony's table, not a statement that the console has no inlet. features.power_inlet stays null.

Sony's PS3 model-differences page groups CECH-2100/2000 at '約3.0～3.2kg' (a range over two series); the CECH-2000 releases both say 3.2 kg. A vertical stand (CECH-ZS1) is sold separately; features.stand_included is not filed because no included-items list says it explicitly for the stand.
media: the drive's loading mechanism is not stated; media stays uncovered. released = NA/EU/Asia date (Japan 2009-09-03). external_ids: Wikidata Q89924544 ('PlayStation 3 Slim').
